reason: Native storage already deserializes the database bank through the exact Bank model, which ignores unknown fields; readiness should compare that same validated model, while preserving historical raw data.
required_contract: Deserialize both expected public bank and selected database bank as exact accepted Bank type; run existing validation on both.
Compare every serialized known field and every vector order; retain exact version and required-field checks.
Bound the selected bank bytes; preserve missing-version and malformed-input refusal.
No UPDATE, INSERT, DELETE, version relabelling, codebook rewrite or digest recomputation.
Keep types.rs and historical corpus/digest/participations byte/content unchanged.
Prove old raw equality refusal versus new typed equality acceptance for extra fields only; all scientific field/order changes remain refused.
risks_and_limits: The changed guard accepts historical metadata which the native runtime ignores; it does not certify meaning or integrity of those unknown fields.
No approved codebook reference is present; no new corpus version or import is warranted from these observations.
A real changed scientific field, missing required field, invalid ID, version or reordered production must still fail.
A new server artifact and candidate qualification are required; this decision alone authorizes no activation.
scope: independent assessment of a proposed code correction, not implementation approval
